title: DriftVerdict
description: Exit code of an OFFLINE drift check: in sync, drift, or error.
$comment: A check exits 0 when the tree is in sync, 1 when it found drift its producer can regenerate, and 2 when the check itself could not decide (an exception, a missing tool, an unresolvable pin). The three must never collapse: before this enum every uncaught Python exception also exited 1, so a broken check read as drift and unlocked a producer on a drift-free tree (S29-00b cold-review F4, rejected as an accepted limitation by Ray 2026-10-01). The description stays one line because it becomes the generated class docstring and ruff's E501 applies to generated code too.
